Voted keep 8 / cut 1. Pregame slate is injury-heavy; blowout and minutes caps matter on DET-WAS and several NBA fronts. I kept legs where usage or matchup gap clearly beats a near-fair book line and cut or downgraded where the market already prices the outcome (NHL SOG) or QB/return-from-injury variance dominates. Treat TOR-PHI usage narratives as scenario-specific and confirm PrizePicks lines match the proxies cited.

Voted keep 6 / cut 3. Slate is situational with mixed value. Key binaries: McCarthy's hip (affects L3), Embiid status (affects L5), Diabate's first game back (affects L8), and blowout risk in DET-WAS (affects L6-L7). The lines are mostly reasonable; usage spike from injuries (LeBron out, Duren out) inflates some props but doesn't guarantee hits. Suitable for flex entry with caution.
